description: Add AI generation buttons to PlannerLesson.jsx for Starter, Main, Plenary, Evaluation, and Homework steps. Depends on FEAT-002 (src/services/ai.js).
steps: 1. READ src/pages/PlannerLesson.jsx in full before modifying it.
2. READ src/services/ai.js to confirm generateLessonPlan and generateAssessment signatures.
acceptance_criteria: Starter, Main, Plenary, Evaluation, Homework steps each have an AI generate button above the textarea.
Button is disabled (with tooltip 'Link this topic to a curriculum indicator first') when currDetails is null.
Button shows a spinner while loading.
On success, the textarea content is replaced with the AI-generated text.
On failure, a red error message appears below the textarea.
No regressions to existing stepper navigation, save-on-blur, or status cycling.
npm run build passes with zero errors.
verification: npm run build  (must complete without errors)
